title: Insert Text
text: Draw text on images or video frames, 9 inputs, 4 outputs, {Font face} sets Font of text; {Text}, {Color value source} sets the source of text color Specify, {Color value} sets the text color value, {Location source} sets the source of location indices Specify via, {Location [x y]} sets the text location index, {Opacity source} sets the source of opacity factor Specify via, {Opacity}, {Image signal} sets the input and output signal format One multidimensional, {Input image is transposed (data order is row major)} sets the mirror text and text location, {Font size (points)} and {Anti-aliased} sets the smooth text edges. Values come from the instance.
